findings.title: Restart leaves disconnected flag set
findings.problem: restartBtn handler runs 'codemie proxy stop; codemie proxy connect desktop' but never calls clearDisconnected/refreshConnection, unlike the Connect handler.
findings.impact: After Disconnect then Restart, Claude Desktop is reconnected but Home still shows 'not connected' and the Disconnect button stays hidden. Whether Restart is reachable in the disconnected state was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: clearDisconnected(homeStorage); refreshConnection(); in the restartBtn click handler after ensureAuthenticated.

fix.change: Restart handler clears disconnected flag and refreshes connection
